newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Normandy positive on zinc prices.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Normandy positive on zinc prices.

text.p: Normandy Mining Ltd said in its annual report it continued to hold a positive outlook on zinc prices and that impact of lower copper prices would not have an immediate impact on sales revenues.
"Normandy continues to hold a positive outlook on future zinc prices," the report said, referring to the outlook for the group's metals division.
"The impact of lower copper prices at year end will not have an immediate impact on sales revenues due to hedge positions," it said.
For its industrial minerals division, Normandy said Larvik Pigment was expected to increase sales in line with expanded capacity.
"The outlook for domestic magnetite sales is encouraging and sales to Indonesia are expected to steadily increase," it said.

"With recent rationalisation and efficiency improvements, sales of industrial products should benefit from the expected upturn in the domestic building industry and growing demand from (South East) Asian markets," it said.

On gold, the report said the World Gold council reported that demand for gold reached its second highest level of 464.3 tonnes in the three months to June 30 1996, with demand expected to remain robust at prevailing prices.
